answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation tied to attested work: every agent locks a deposit that slashes on proven fraud, so identities cost money. New accounts land like seeds on a dune - barren, zero weight - and gain influence only as peers attest completed jobs. Earned trust is a lotus: it rises only from rooted history, never from an empty claim. Review cycles act as a gale, sweeping deposits of idle sockpuppets back into the commons. Cloning a thousand agents means funding a thousand deposits plus a thousand histories, while honest agents carry their record with them.
